# Cyprys Video Downloader for Windows

> Portable video downloader for Windows that saves videos from a link in up to 4K, 1080p or as MP3 audio, with playlist and subtitle download.

- Download: https://github.com/WraithEchoAdapter/rep1/releases/latest/download/CyprysVideoDownloader.zip
- Source code: https://github.com/DivinerResurrect/cyprys-video-downloader
- Platform: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit), portable .exe, no installation
- License: MIT, free for personal and commercial use
- Updated: 2026-10-01

## What it does
- Download a video from a link: Paste the address of a page with a video and the app lists every available format with its size, before anything is downloaded. Pick one and press Download.
- Download videos in 4K or 1080p: Set a default quality once: best available, 1080p Full HD, 720p for smaller files, or audio only. The app picks the closest format the site offers.
- Convert video to MP3: Save only the sound as MP3, M4A, WAV or OPUS, for lectures, podcasts and music you are allowed to keep. Video can be saved as MP4, MKV or WEBM.
- Download a whole playlist at once: Paste a playlist link and every video in it is queued with the same settings. The queue shows progress, speed and time left for each file.
- Download subtitles with the video: Save subtitles in the languages you choose when the video has them, and embed the thumbnail and title into the file so your library stays tidy.

## FAQ
### How do I download a video from a website on Windows?
Download Video Downloader, unzip it and run the .exe. Copy the link of the page with the video, press Paste, choose a quality and press Download. The file is saved to your Videos\Downloads folder.

### How do I download a video in 1080p or 4K?
After you paste the link, the app lists every format the site offers. Pick 1080p or 2160p (4K) from the list, or set a default quality in the settings. If a site has no 4K version, the app cannot create one.

### How do I save a video as MP3?
Choose Audio only in the format list, or set MP3 as the default audio format. The app saves just the sound track, which is handy for lectures and podcasts.

### How do I download a whole playlist?
Paste the playlist link instead of a single video link. With Whole playlist from one link turned on, every video is added to the queue with the same quality and format.

### Is it legal to download videos from the internet?
It depends on the video and where you live. Saving your own videos, videos under a Creative Commons license, public domain footage or videos you have the owner's permission to download is fine. Downloading copyrighted videos without permission can break copyright law and a site's terms of service. Please download only what you have the right to keep.

### Can it download from Netflix or other paid streaming services?
No. Paid streaming services protect their videos with DRM, and Video Downloader does not bypass copy protection. It works with videos that a site makes available without DRM.
